title: version set exits 0 having written nothing into a structured version file with no version line, and writes the sidecars before failing on a version file it cannot write
body:
`version set` can report success having written nothing, and it can leave a half-written set. apply_version runs a preflight pass before its write pass so that "a refusal never strands a half-written set" (lib/cmd/version, apply_version's header): every file raises its refusal while the tree is still as it was, and only then is anything written. The cases below get past the preflight. Found by vc on 2026-10-27, reviewing dc's 0259 bank.

## Measured

vc, 2026-10-27. Run with devbin 0.1.15 from brew, whose lib/cmd/version and lib/helpers are unchanged on main since v0.1.15, in a scratch project seeded with `devbin install --into` (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/meas-setnoop/proj).

- **A structured version file with no version line.** project.version_from was Cargo.toml, and the Cargo.toml held a workspace (`[workspace]`, `members = ["a"]`) and no version line. `version set 0.1.0` printed `unknown` and exited 0, and Cargo.toml's sha256 was the same before and after.
  - write_version_into's preflight passes any existing Cargo.toml, mix.exs or package.json.
  - In the write pass the recipe's sed replaces the line read_version reads, and there is none, so it changes nothing.
  - `set` then prints read_version's answer, `unknown`, and exits 0 (lib/cmd/version:294-298).
  - By the same code (read, not run), a sidecar of those kinds with no version line is passed and left unchanged.
- **A version file that cannot be written.** VERSION held 1.0.0 with mode 444, and a sidecar, notes.txt, held 1.0.0. `version set 1.0.1` wrote notes.txt as 1.0.1. It then failed on VERSION with bash's own "lib/cmd/version: line 181: VERSION: Permission denied", exited 1, and left VERSION at 1.0.0. The preflight never asks whether a file can be written.
- release's stamp step runs `version set` and trusts its exit (lib/cmd/release:845-847).

## Fix

The preflight refuses, before any file is written, each file its write would not change:
- a structured file (Cargo.toml, mix.exs, package.json or a plist) in which read_version reads no version, since the write replaces only the line read_version reads. The refusal names the file, the key that declares it, and that it holds no version line to replace.
- a file its kind's write cannot change, named, asked last so its remedy is never moot. The question differs by kind, because the writes differ:
  - A bare file or a plist is written in place, so it must be writable (`-w`).
  - Cargo.toml, mix.exs and package.json are written through sed_inplace and replace_file, which stage a copy beside the file and rename it over. "A READ-ONLY FILE IS STILL REPLACED, AND KEEPS ITS MODE" (lib/helpers:712-716, ST0007 WP-02, held by helpers.bats:954). So for these kinds the file must be readable at the end of its links, and its directory must be writable and searchable.
  - A plain `-w` would refuse a read-only Cargo.toml that main writes, and would pass a writable one in a directory that takes no new file, whose write then fails after the earlier sidecars took the version. dc's critic-shell review of the first bank found both, and vc accepted the per-kind rule on 2026-10-27.
- The refusals use version_unread's wording for the version file and one clause for a sidecar. An unreadable structured sidecar is told it cannot be read, and is not told it holds no version line. `version check` reports a structured sidecar that is empty or has no line as holding no version devbin reads, so it no longer prescribes a `version sync` that sync would refuse.

Issue 0259 starts a missing version file of the bare kind, refusing one whose directory cannot be written. This issue builds on it.

## Done when

1. With project.version_from naming a Cargo.toml that has no version line, `version set 0.1.0` exits non-zero, naming the file and project.version_from, and changes no file. The same holds for a sidecar of a structured kind with no version line, naming project.version_sidecars. An arm for each, red on main.
2. With a bare version file read-only and a sidecar declared, `version set` exits non-zero naming the version file, and the sidecar is unchanged. A Cargo.toml sidecar in a directory that takes no new file, declared after a bare sidecar, is refused, and the bare sidecar is unchanged. Each is an arm, red on main. A read-only Cargo.toml version file is still written and keeps its mode, as on main, which an arm guards.
3. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (version.bats and releasecut.bats, with the tree scans and help), and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

0260 is fixed by 446a11c6 (tree 24043a26), the second of the version chain's five commits on b6752347 (0259 d6a37fb3, then 0260, then 0263 eda8efd6, 0264 b2e5c2b3 and 0265 1792ae25). The bundle's tip is the tip the landing run tested, 1792ae25.

### What changed, against "Done when"

1. **[x] With project.version_from naming a Cargo.toml that has no version line, `version set 0.1.0` exits non-zero, naming the file and project.version_from, and changes no file; the same for a structured sidecar with no version line, naming project.version_sidecars. An arm for each, red on main.**
   - lib/helpers: version_unread words a structured file in which read_version reads no version as "holds no version devbin reads", an empty value included, and version_file_state answers `noversion` for it.
   - lib/cmd/version: write_version_into's preflight refuses it in either role before anything is written. At the tip that is one version_unread question in the file's role (0265).
   - Arms: "version set refuses a version file of a structured kind with no version devbin reads, naming it and project.version_from, and changes no file (0260)" and "version set refuses a sidecar of a structured kind with no version devbin reads, naming it and project.version_sidecars, before writing anything (0260)".
2. **[x] A read-only bare version file with a sidecar declared is refused naming the version file, the sidecar unchanged; a Cargo.toml sidecar in a directory that takes no new file, declared after a bare sidecar, is refused, the bare sidecar unchanged; each an arm red on main; a read-only Cargo.toml version file is still written and keeps its mode, guarded by an arm.**
   - lib/helpers: replace_problem, beside replace_file, says why replace_file could not replace a file, asking only what stage_beside needs: a link it can follow, a readable file, and a directory that takes a new file and a rename. version_unwritten asks by kind: a bare file or a plist is written in place, so it must be writable; a Cargo.toml, mix.exs or package.json is rewritten as a copy renamed over it, so it asks replace_problem.
   - version_unread takes `write`, the writer's question, and answers it last (`nowrite`), so its remedy is never moot.
   - Arms: "version set refuses a version file or a sidecar it cannot write, naming it, before writing anything (0260)" (a 0444 VERSION with notes.txt declared, then a 0444 notes.txt), and "version set refuses a Cargo.toml sidecar in a directory that takes no new file, before writing the bare sidecar listed ahead of it (0260)". The guard is "version set rewrites a read-only Cargo.toml, which keeps its mode, as replace_file does (0260)".
3. **[x] The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (version.bats and releasecut.bats, with the tree scans and help).** CI on the pushed head is vc's landing to read.
- The Fix's other items:
  - a sidecar devbin cannot read is refused as one that "cannot be read", never taken as empty. Arm: "set and check say a structured sidecar devbin cannot read cannot be read, and neither calls it empty (0260)";
  - check reports an empty or line-less structured sidecar as holding no version devbin reads, and names no sync. Arm: "check calls an empty Cargo.toml sidecar one that holds no version devbin reads, and names no sync, which refuses it (0260)";
  - a read-only plist sidecar and a plist with no version key are refused before anything is written, on macOS. Arm: "version set refuses a read-only plist sidecar, and one with no version key, before writing anything (0260)".
- **0264's P2 and P3 are taken here** (vc), in this commit's preflight: a bare sidecar devbin cannot read is refused, not taken as empty, and a version file devbin can write but not read is refused before it is written. The arms are "version set refuses a bare sidecar devbin cannot read before writing anything, and its text survives (0260, 0264)" and "version set refuses a version file devbin can write but not read, naming it, rather than print unknown at exit 0 (0260, 0264)". RESOLUTION-0264 says the same.
- lib/pages/version.md says what set refuses, and how each kind is asked whether it can be written.

### The critic review

- **The first bank's review.** The critic-shell subagent reviewed 91737d3c against 4d9d7d5c (0259's bank then): 1 critical, 4 warnings, 6 recommendations and 1 style, and said the bank should not land. The re-bank settled it, and this commit is the settled unit.
  - **CRITICAL (Highlander, `-w` was the wrong question for the cargo, mix and npm recipes, both ways):** it refused a read-only manifest main writes (replace_file keeps a read-only file's mode, lib/helpers, ST0007 WP-02, held by helpers.bats), and passed a writable one in a directory that takes no new file, whose write then half-wrote the set. Taken: the per-kind rule above, which vc accepted on 2026-10-27 and wrote into the issue, with both arms the critic proposed.
  - **WARNING (Highlander, check prescribed a sync that sync refused, for an empty structured sidecar):** taken. check's `empty` is for the bare kind only, with the arm.
  - **WARNING (Highlander, three duplications: version_unread's frame hand-written, two wordings for one sidecar state, the kinds restated):** taken. The version file's refusals are version_unread's, and refuse_sidecar was the one wording of a sidecar's refusals here; the restated kinds are moot at the tip, where the preflight asks the classifier. The one-classifier refactor was ruled separate by vc and filed as 0265, which removes refuse_sidecar.
  - **WARNING (No Silent Errors, an unreadable structured sidecar was told it holds no version line):** taken. `-r` is asked first.
  - **WARNING (the page's new sentence was untrue in four places):** taken. The sentence now says what the code does.
  - **Recommendations taken:** writability asked last; "holds no version devbin reads" for an empty value too; a bare sidecar listed ahead of the structured file in the arms, so "before any file is written" can be seen; plist arms, skipped off macOS; the root skip through permission_case_built's rule; the comments made true.
  - **Recommendation not taken:** release's pre-flight running apply_version's preflight pass, offered as optional.
  - **The pre-existing defects its probes hit** were filed by vc: P1 as 0263, and P2 to P4 as 0264.
- **The whole chain's review.** The critic-shell subagent reviewed the chain 056db50d..4c6fe838 (0260 to 0265 as then built): 2 critical, 5 warnings, 4 recommendations and 4 style. Its settlement, e62c7e50, was folded into each unit it belongs to (m2/refold.sh). For 0260:
  - its arms were each red at the base, and passed at the tip under BSD, GNU and mawk;
  - **WARNING (a uchg, immutable, Cargo.toml sidecar passes the preflight, and the write pass half-writes the set):** outside the issue's rule. Filed as 0279;
  - **Recommendation not taken:** the version file's refusal for a project root that takes no new file prints the absolute project path, since the strip removes only "<root>/". The settlement's probe (0260/review/extra.settle.bsd.out) still prints it, and no record I read files it.
- **The critic leg** ran `intent critic shell` on the light's 12 changed shell files, lib/helpers and lib/cmd/version among them, and exited 0. It asked 2 of its 6 rules.

### Which arms are red on main, and which hold unchanged behaviour

- **Red on the base** (red clone a6ceaf72):
  - "version set refuses a version file of a structured kind with no version devbin reads, naming it and project.version_from, and changes no file (0260)": exit 0, printing unknown, for the issue's reason;
  - "version set refuses a sidecar of a structured kind with no version devbin reads, naming it and project.version_sidecars, before writing anything (0260)": exit 0, printing 1.0.1;
  - "version set refuses a version file or a sidecar it cannot write, naming it, before writing anything (0260)": first on the message, bash's own "VERSION: Permission denied"; the chain's critic measured the base half-written underneath;
  - "version set refuses a Cargo.toml sidecar in a directory that takes no new file, before writing the bare sidecar listed ahead of it (0260)": first on the message, mktemp's "Permission denied"; half-written underneath, as measured;
  - "check calls an empty Cargo.toml sidecar one that holds no version devbin reads, and names no sync, which refuses it (0260)": the base says "empty (expected 1.0.0)" and prescribes sync;
  - "set and check say a structured sidecar devbin cannot read cannot be read, and neither calls it empty (0260)": set fails with cp's "Permission denied";
  - "version set refuses a bare sidecar devbin cannot read before writing anything, and its text survives (0260, 0264)": exit 0, the prose overwritten with 1.0.1;
  - "version set refuses a version file devbin can write but not read, naming it, rather than print unknown at exit 0 (0260, 0264)": exit 0, printing unknown;
  - "version set refuses a read-only plist sidecar, and one with no version key, before writing anything (0260)": exit 0 after PlistBuddy's "Error Opening Destination".
- **Holds unchanged behaviour, green on the base and at the tip:** "version set rewrites a read-only Cargo.toml, which keeps its mode, as replace_file does (0260)", the guard Done when 2 names.
- **Changed and green at the tip:** "check passes and NAMES ITS DENOMINATOR when every sidecar agrees" now reads its count from SIDECAR_FILES, the list sidecar_project's config is written from, rather than a number written by hand. It carries no chain tag, so the arms phase did not run it on the red clone. The light ran version.bats whole.

- **The light:** as in RESOLUTION-0259, in slot 01M61KEFYSZNEHCP7S5D3J9N6J.
  - START was 15:53:38Z and the driver exited 0 at 16:33:18Z, both by date -u.
  - It ran at the line's tip 992cd9d8, whose history holds the chain. version (73) and releasecut (140) ran whole under BSD and GNU, with help (58), the rest of both stages' files and the tree scans, and every test passed.
  - The log is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/r23b/run23-01M61KEFYSZNEHCP7S5D3J9N6J.log.
- **Probes:** 0260/review/settle-probe.{bash,out}, 0260/review/critic.report.md (the first bank's review), and 0260/review/cr0260chain-0528/ (the chain's) with extra.settle.{bsd,gnu}.out.
